title: Jellyfish UFO In Rainbow Over Alaskan Military Base Busted By UFOlogists; It’s Not What You Think It Is
description: Sarah Jane Osborn clicked and videographed what seems like definite evidence of jellyfish UFOs, but could it be something more ordinary than perceived? There’s no general consensus, but the viral Alaskan clip is probably not a mystery anymore.

title: Alaska Jellyfish UFO Mystery Takes Bizarre Turn as Experts Reveal What Was Spotted Near US Military Base
description: A jellyfish-shaped object filmed near an Alaska military base has prompted UFO speculation, though UAP experts say it was most likely an unusual high-altitude balloon or kite-like device.

title: UFO Panic After 'Sky Jellyfish Alien' Appears Near Us Base, but the Truth May Just Be an Octopus Kite
description: A jellyfish-shaped object filmed over Anchorage prompted UFO speculation, but footage analysis suggests it may have been a tethered octopus kite, although no definitive identification has been made.

title: Social media reacts with snarky jokes amid UFO discussions and sightings
description: Jokes about UFO sightings have been floating around social media after lawmakers held "Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Exposing the Truth," to discuss UAPs.

title: Photos: Aliens invade McMinnville, Oregon for UFO Festival Parade
description: Aliens and earthlings converged on McMinnville, Oregon for the 25th annual UFO Festival – a weekend full of events for believers and skeptics alike.
